Does Aetna Cover Addiction Treatment?

The National Institute of Health (NIH) reported that 10% of Americans have had a substance use disorder at one point in their lives. This breaks down to one in ten individuals. Additionally, the NIH reported that approximately 4% of Americans currently meet the criteria for a drug use disorder. Addiction and mental health have continuously been a focus of Public Health organizations and will continue to be as long as Americans continue to struggle.

Aetna is a healthcare company that provides health insurance coverage to 39 million Americans annually. Aetna is known to provide addiction treatment for its members. It is important to note that since Aetna offers individualized health care plans, there will be variations in their member’s plans and received benefits.

Marina Harbor Detox provides medical detox in San Francisco, CA. Our Marin County drug rehab facility can provide you with a holistic detoxification and inpatient rehab program. This would include nutrition services, exercise opportunities, and nature walks. We are purposely a six-person facility so that we can provide you with the individualized time needed to be successful in your recovery. Call 1-866-525-3026 to learn more about how Marina Harbor Detox can support you.
Does Aetna Cover Drug Detox?

For individuals struggling with drug or alcohol use, you may be relieved to learn that Aetna provides coverage for addiction treatment. This includes both inpatient and outpatient treatment services. Inpatient treatment options include detoxification and inpatient rehab programs. Outpatient addiction treatment programs include partial hospitalization, intensive outpatient, routine outpatient, dual-diagnosis, and medication-assisted treatment.

Marina Harbor Detox is an Aetna drug and alcohol detox center in San Francisco, California. We provide detox services for individuals struggling with alcohol, drugs, and suboxone. After completing our detox program, you can continue your treatment with our inpatient rehab program. Our holistic approach to treatment will help you feel prepared for your recovery when you leave our facility. To learn more about how Marina Harbor Detox can help you, we invite you to call 1-866-525-3026 today.
How Long Will Aetna Cover Drug Rehab?

We encourage you to call Aetna directly to learn more about the duration that Aetna will provide drug rehab coverage. Because Aetna offers personalized coverage plans, your coverage may vary from others. Additionally, factors such as the severity of your addiction, the presence of other mental health needs, and other stressors will be considered by Aetna when determining the length of coverage.

How to Verify Aetna Insurance Addiction Treatment Coverage

Before you can verify your insurance, you will want to have an idea of what level of treatment you need. To learn this, you can talk to your Primary Care Physician or other healthcare providers about your concerns. After learning more about your use, concerns, and goals, your healthcare provider can talk to you about the different options, such as detoxification, inpatient rehab programs, and outpatient treatment. Once you know what kind of treatment program you are looking for, you can proceed with verifying your coverage. The admissions team at Marina Harbor Detox can help verify your Aetna drug coverage for you.

Marina Harbor Detox Accepts Aetna Insurance

Marina Harbor Detox is the ideal San Francisco Aetna drug rehab. As a six-person facility, our staff can spend time focusing on each individual we work with. This individualized care can help you identify goals for your recovery, sources of motivation, triggers, and known challenges. Our detoxification program will focus on helping you find comfort while you progress through withdrawal. When we stop using alcohol and drugs, we abruptly change how our body functions. For many, this leads to uncomfortable withdrawal symptoms.

Our inpatient drug and alcohol rehab is a true, holistic treatment program. This means that we treat more than your addiction. We recognize that a healthy recovery is made possible when we work to improve all the areas of our life that were impacted by active addiction. This includes our medical health, mental health, relationships, nutrition, exercise behaviors, and spiritual wellness. At Marina Harbor Detox, you will access our nutrition services, exercise opportunities and enjoy nature walks.

Struggling with an alcohol or drug addiction is often an isolating experience. This can make asking for help and building a healthy support system challenging. At the Marina Harbor Detox, we understand the challenges that often arise in recovery and work with you to develop an effective relapse prevention plan, so you feel confident about returning to your home environment.
